description:
A tactical 2D top-down puzzle game inspired by the mechanics of 2048. Instead of numbers, you combine survival resources: food increases health, weapons enhance attack, and armor increases defense. 

By merging identical items, you create stronger versions and decide what to develop next. Your goal is to strategically combine resources and prepare your heroes for the upcoming night, where any mistake could cost them their lives.

It's not about armor or crests anymore. The hour has come for those whose power is born of the very nature of rage and magic. It's time for new heroes to take up what has become their continuation: a jagged staff that has absorbed the wrath of the earth; a taut bow singing the songs of the wind; a battered grimoire in which the souls of forgotten gods whisper. Their battle is not a battle pattern, but a ritual.

Everything happens in a tense rhythm of day and night. During the day, you can combine items on the field and collect ready-made supplies in your supplies. At night, when the world is frozen in terror, all you can do is desperately try to put the pieces together.
